latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Image to Video AI Generator.

- Instantly animates still images into engaging, AI-generated videos with motion effects, transitions, and cinematic touches.
- No editing skills or software required; submit an image or describe what you want to generate video content.
- Cloud-based rendering with free, temporary credits and secure session handling via API.
- Supports various user intents: uploading images, checking credits, downloading videos, and more.
- Automatic error handling with user-friendly prompts for expired tokens, session issues, credits, and file format problems.
